heading: Other judicial review prohibited
lead: Except as expressly authorized by this chapter and chapter 5 of title 3, the compliance or noncompliance with the provisions of chapter 5 of title 3, and any action taken pursuant to chapter 5 of title 3, shall not be subject to judicial review.

notes.text: Effective DateSection effective Oct. 1, 1997, see section 3(d) of Pub. L. 104–331, set out as a note under section 1296 of this title.

ancestors.heading: JUDICIAL REVIEW OF CERTAIN ACTIONS BY PRESIDENTIAL OFFICES
